name: Kassadin
title: the Void Walker

Q.name: Null Sphere
Q.description: Kassadin fires an orb of void energy, dealing 65/95/125/155/185 + 0.8×AP magic damage and interrupting channels. Kassadin also gains 80/110/140/170/200 + 0.3×AP Magic Shield for 1.5 seconds.
Q.summary: Kassadin fires an orb of void energy at a target, dealing damage and interrupting channels. The excess energy forms around himself, granting a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage.

W.name: Nether Blade
W.description: Passive: Kassadin's Attacks deal an additional 25 + 0.1×AP magic damage. Active: Kassadin charges his blade, causing his next Attack to deal 50/75/100/125/150 + 0.8×AP magic damage and restore 4/4.5/5/5.5/6% missing Mana, increased to 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% against champions.
W.summary: Passive: Kassadin's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. Active: Kassadin's next basic attack deals significant bonus magic damage and restores Mana.

E.name: Force Pulse
E.description: Passive: Force Pulse's Cooldown is reduced by 0.75 second whenever any Ability is used near Kassadin. Active: Kassadin unleashes a void pulse, dealing 70/100/130/160/190 + 0.7×AP magic damage and Slowing by 50/55/60/65/70% for 1 second.
E.summary: Kassadin draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity. Upon charging up, Kassadin can use Force Pulse to damage and slow enemies in a cone in front of him.

R.name: Riftwalk
R.description: Kassadin teleports to a nearby location, dealing 80/95/110 + 0.5×AP + ? magic damage. Each subsequent use of this Ability within the next 15 seconds doubles the Mana cost and deals an additional 35/45/55 + 0.07×AP + ? magic damage. The cost and damage increases can stack up to 4 times.
R.summary: Kassadin teleports to a nearby location dealing damage to nearby enemy units. Multiple Riftwalks in a short period of time cost additional Mana but also deal additional damage.

Passive.name: Void Stone
Passive.description: Kassadin takes reduced magic damage and ignores unit collision.
Passive.summary: Kassadin takes reduced magic damage and ignores unit collision.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Kassadin is a scaling mage assassin who resists magic damage with Void Stone and blinks with Riftwalk. He plays mid, survives a weak early game, and becomes a late-game monster.
strengths: Riftwalk is a short-cooldown blink, making him one of the most mobile mages late.
Null Sphere gives a magic shield and interrupts channels.
Void Stone reduces magic damage, so he is strong against AP mid laners.
Huge late-game scaling: stacked Riftwalk deals more damage each time.
Force Pulse slows and its cooldown drops whenever abilities are used near him.
weaknesses: Very weak early: melee range and low damage before level 6.
Void Stone only helps against magic damage; AD champions bully him.
Mana-hungry: chained Riftwalks double in cost.
Easily poked out of lane before 6.
Needs farm and levels to scale, so roaming early is costly.

curve.lvl1: weak – melee range and low damage; he only wants to last-hit
curve.lvl2: weak – Q's magic shield helps against AP poke but he can't trade
curve.lvl3: okay – E slow adds a short trade
curve.lvl6: good – Riftwalk gives a blink to reach targets or escape
curve.items: strong – first item: Rod of Ages, Seraph's Embrace and Rabadon's Deathcap
curve.late: very strong – one of the best late-game champions

profile.curveNote: Kassadin is weak early and wants to reach 6 safely, then scale into the late game.

profile.windowAgainst: Kassadin's window is levels 1–5: all-in him, because he has short range and low damage.
